# Welcome to Our Blog

This is a sample blog post. Replace this content with your own.

## Getting Started

Add your blog posts as MDX files in `content/blog/` and compile them into `content/blog-data.json`.

## What You Can Write About

- Product updates and announcements
- Tutorials and how-to guides
- Industry insights
- Case studies

Happy writing!
